status: Authored and internally reviewed; mechanical/browser gates pass; native review pending
method: Compare publishers' own structure and usage sections, not search snippets or generated related-point summaries. Level tags are editorial estimates. All instructional sentences will be original; no source audio/examples imported.

points.formation: Noun/noun phrase + について + discussion/question verb; noun + についての + noun. A clause is first nominalised with こと/の where appropriate. No direct dictionary verb + について.
points.teachingChoice: Earlier N4 reading had supported exposure; now teach topic versus viewpoint explicitly. Do not ask learners to choose among several acceptable ways to discuss a topic.

points.form: target and contrast に対して
points.formation: Target noun + に対して; target noun + に対する + noun. Contrast uses verb/い-adjective plain clause + のに対して; な-adjective + なのに対して; noun + なのに対して or であるのに対して.
points.teachingChoice: Teach target-directed response and one explicitly contrasted pair. No assertion that 対 always means hostile opposition. Score attributive に対する as a named form task, not an exclusive synonym question.

points.formation: Standpoint noun + にとって (は/も) + evaluation. Usually kana; no kanji etymology is taught.
points.teachingChoice: Someone can find something valuable or difficult from their own standpoint. It is not an all-purpose beneficiary/purpose marker. Avoid universal claims about learners or a fixed automatic sentiment label.

points.form: dependence, method, cause and agent によって/による
points.formation: Noun + によって/により + clause; noun + による + noun. Predicate noun + による means depend on. Context supplies dependence, method, cause or passive agent; not every noun denotes a tool naturally. によると marks a reporting source and is taught separately.
points.teachingChoice: Use explicit changing conditions and a named survey method. Examples separately label cause and a passive creator; retrieve N4 passive rather than inventing a new derivation. No blanket replacement for で or a false equation with reporting によると.

remaining: Native naturalness/listening review and full advanced inventory reconciliation remain outstanding.
